definitions.binary: the clean binary design measured under the comparison profile (Emin as in the profile)
definitions.clean: union of 8-connected components touching the support nodes, the input port nodes and the output port nodes; the rest are islands
definitions.connectivity_threshold_max: largest level in 0.05..0.95 (step 0.05) at which the load path is connected and restrained
definitions.floor_free: the clean binary design with Emin = 0 and every floating node fixed (void removed)
definitions.geometry_valid: connected and restrained at the threshold
definitions.gray: the recorded field measured under the comparison profile (should equal the recorded descriptors)
definitions.outline: exact element-edge loops in mm, solid on the left; corner contacts split
definitions.restrained: at least 2 distinct support nodes attached to the clean design
definitions.solid: rho >= threshold on the design domain; passive solid forced in, passive void forced out
definitions.thin_necks: the load path breaks after a morphological opening with a 1-element disk
